title: STA read commands for the holder's contact
result: `caceres datos-personales` and `junta datos-personales` read `PAGE_CODE=DATOS_PERSONALES` (phone, e-mail, confirmed or not, identity and addresses when shown); `caceres padron` reads `DATOS_HABITANTE`. The Junta sede keeps no padrón: its page answers "Se ha producido un error al buscar los datos del padrón", so no `junta padron` was built.
evidence: live runs 2026-10-16 with [redacted] at both sedes (Cáceres confirmed, Junta still asking "¿Los medios de contacto son correctos?") and `caceres padron` for [redacted] (registered, two cohabitants) and [redacted] (`registered: false`); `pnpm check:ci` green.
